name: Domesday Book
short_desc: A royal survey records landholdings and resources across much of England and parts of Wales.
date_note: Traditionally dated to 1086; some scholarship places compilation of the surviving book as late as 1098–1114. These bounds represent competing datings, not a continuous 28-year composition. The survey was ordered in 1085.
notes: New source-linked entry. The Wikipedia introduction, date evidence and article identity received an initial editorial check; independent claim-specific source review remains open.
